def probe_run(s, name, probe, case, k, threads, extra, timeout=600):
    stem = Path(s.data) / DATA[case]
    r = s.run(name, [probe, str(stem) + '.u32le', str(stem) + '.ids.u32le', '--k=%d' % k, '--leaf=24',
                     '--threads=%d' % threads] + extra, timeout)
    out = parse(r['stdout'])
    out.update(code=r['code'], timeout=r['timeout'], seconds=r['seconds'])
    return out
